# vMLX 1.6.64

## Changes

- Preserve schema-declared string arguments in XML tool calls, including the Qwen XML route. JSON-looking text remains a string instead of being decoded into an object or array. (`42fe9daf6`, `2749abdb7`)
- Prevent malformed tool arguments from crashing chat tool previews. (`9e92fa929`)
- This is a focused correctness release. Existing runtime precision, sampling, MTP and cache defaults are unchanged; experimental cold-start optimizations are not included.

## Runtime provenance

- vMLX source: `bb3482e792bb9310b4c5490de170c38929bf27fe`
- JANG runtime: `f3c79081c3d99e8a26fa28444934f7567acb00c6` (`jang 2.5.47`)
- Tahoe/macOS 26 is the default build; Sequoia is the compatibility build.
- Both DMGs are Developer ID signed, independently notarized, stapled, and Gatekeeper checked by the candidate workflow.
